I'm going through the user story checks one by one. QUS-001 passes, since it has a clear role and an action. QUS-002 fails: it bundles sharing the URL, downloading the image, and sharing the image to social networks into one story, so it isn't atomic. QUS-003 passes because there are no parentheses. I'm now starting on QUS-004.

For QUS-004, the benefit "use and share the data I have found" seems to restate the sharing action, so I'm leaning toward marking it as failing, though it's a judgment call. QUS-005 passes, since it focuses on the problem rather than a technical component. QUS-006 looks ambiguous because "view state" is undefined jargon.

I'm checking the remaining stories against the criteria. QUS-006 fails on undefined terms like "view state" and unspecified social networks, and QUS-007 through QUS-009 look fine, with no conflicts or duplicates and a consistent template. For the INV checks, INV-002 passes because the benefit is there, while INV-003 fails since the networks, image format, and view states are still unspecified.

I'm checking the INV-004 sizing next, though it depends on estimation. INV-005 fails since there are no acceptance criteria. For DOR-001, I'm noting that sharing to social networks likely needs third-party integration that isn't mentioned, so that fails too. DOR-002 is less clear: there are no stated rules on which networks are supported or how errors are handled, but I don't yet have solid evidence for it.

I'm working through the remaining defect checks: DOR-003 doesn't apply since there are no critical NFRs or high volume concerns. Summing up what I've flagged so far, the main issues are QUS-002, QUS-004, QUS-006, INV-003, DOR-001, and DOR-002 as major, with INV-005 as blocking. Next I'll check whether INV-004 should be flagged by estimating the work, which means pulling in the estimation reference first.

I'm going to pull in the estimation scale and reference points in parallel to decide whether INV-004 should be flagged.

recomendaciones.texto: La HU mezcla tres funcionalidades unidas por 'and': compartir una URL del estado de la vista, descargar una imagen y compartir la imagen en redes. Separarlas en HU independientes, por ejemplo: (a) compartir la URL; (b) descargar la imagen; (c) compartir la imagen en redes que la admitan.

El beneficio 'use and share the data I have found' repite la acción (compartir) en vez de expresar un valor. Redactar un beneficio que justifique la acción, por ejemplo qué logra el usuario al difundir los datos encontrados.

Agregar criterios observables, por ejemplo: 'Al pulsar compartir en la URL, se genera un enlace que reabre la misma vista con sus filtros'; 'Al descargar la imagen, se obtiene un archivo del estado de vista mostrado'.
